about.title: About
about.intro: Yoann Barbier, freelance full-stack developer in Nantes, France, since 2021: React, TypeScript, Node.js, and author of the open-source Axons boilerplate.
about.lead: A freelance full-stack developer in Nantes since 2021, I design and evolve web applications with React, TypeScript and Node.js. I am the author of Axons, the open-source Next.js boilerplate this site is built on.
summary: Author of the open-source Axons boilerplate.
Based in Nantes, available remotely or on site depending on the project.
approach: I work mainly with JavaScript and TypeScript, with particular attention to code quality, performance and the robustness of the solutions.
I like understanding and solving problems, algorithmic ones in particular: I took part in the TopCoder Open marathons, just for the fun of it.
background: CTO of Keople (myKeople SaaS HR platform) from 2014 to 2018, then full-stack lead developer from 2018 to 2021.

services.title: Services
services.intro: What Yoann Barbier, freelance full-stack developer, can do: a site built from Axons, web development with AI, a project ready for coding agents, organising a team project, algorithms.
services.lead: A few things I can help you with today.

items.title: A website or small web application built from Axons
items.body: Within a few days, with code that belongs to you and that your own AI can keep evolving.

items.title: Web development with AI (React, TypeScript, Node.js)
items.body: AI writes a large part of the code; I take care of everything around it: context, rules, tests, review.

items.title: Preparing a project to work with coding agents
items.body: Conventions, documentation for the agents, automated tests, as for Axons.

items.title: Organising a project with several people
items.body: Splitting the work, sharing it out according to what each person prefers to do, and leading by example.

items.title: An algorithm or optimisation problem
items.body: When a good solution has to be found among a great many possibilities.

axons.name: Axons
axons.tagline: Open-source Next.js boilerplate, the foundation of this site
axons.context: Axons is a reusable foundation for building multilingual, search-friendly Next.js websites and web applications. This site, ezjsdev, derives from it: it only adds its identity, pages and content, and takes everything else from Axons.
axons.note: Designed and built entirely with the help of AI (ChatGPT, Qwen, Claude).
axons.role: Author: design, development and maintenance of the project.
contribution: Next.js 16 (App Router) and React 19, in TypeScript
Six languages with translated URLs, hreflang tags, an XML sitemap and structured data
Markdown articles and collections, with server-side code highlighting
Material UI components isolated behind a neutral API, light and dark themes
Extension points to derive a site without modifying the foundation
Unit and end-to-end tests, Storybook, continuous integration and deployment on Netlify

idealco.name: Idealco
idealco.context: Redesign of the idealco.fr website in Next.js 14+, from 2023 to 2025, after a first collaboration with Idealco in 2021-2022.

siteHome.title: Full-stack developer — React, TypeScript, Node.js
siteHome.lead: A freelance full-stack developer in Nantes, I build and evolve websites and web applications in JavaScript and TypeScript, now with the help of AI. I pay close attention to code quality, tests and the reliability of what I deliver.
approach: Understand a problem before solving it, and look for the simplest solution that holds up.
Plan ahead rather than react: set a clear context from the start, to avoid last-minute changes.
Do things properly, even if it takes a little longer, so there is less to come back to later.
Develop with AI (Claude Code, local models) while keeping control of quality, tests and technical choices.
Algorithm and optimisation problems, like those of the TopCoder Open, with approaches such as simulated annealing or beam search.
